div.h1: Pattern B · A2A outbound (remote agent as room member)
div.h3: adapter: a2a: summon over SLIM, call over HTTPS, reply back onto SLIM

text.tspan: The remote never holds a group key: it is not in the MLS group,
it just gets called. The backend seat reads room plaintext (as moderator or custodian)
and calls the remote over plain HTTPS, out of band from SLIM entirely.
Auth is a Bearer token whose env-var name lives in the manifest; the secret stays in
backend env. The card URL is SSRF-guarded.
